subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A baby begins to walk at around 12 months regardless of whether parents actively train them to do so — this unfolding follows a genetically-programmed biological timetable rather than specific learning or practice. This process is called:
explanation: Maturation is the genetically-programmed unfolding of physical and behavioural characteristics on a fairly predictable timetable, largely independent of specific environmental training.
